Handoff 2026-11-18 ~07:25 KST from the Mac. Two sessions ran overnight: the release lead (Mac board, topic current-work-overview) and the sprint/backlog lead. The owner resumes at the office. Office PC rule unchanged: Go tests only on w5090; never run local go test or ws exes on the owner PC (AV).

RELEASES (owner pre-approved deploys overnight)
- v0.50.3 (tag on main): carries almost all of the 2026-11-16/17 work but has NO desktop zips (a stale packaging test in desktop-electron/test/host.test.js failed desktop-build).
- v0.50.4 = 60e0e1421: desktop zips restored; nil launcher-lock diagnostic fixed. 16 assets.
- v0.50.5 = 6bd0f51bf: wsagent data races fixed (permission and runner paths read c.record() copies taken under c.mu); replay drain test deflaked. 16 assets; releases/latest = v0.50.5. The darwin desktop job was cancelled twice by GitHub macOS arm64 runner capacity; `gh run rerun <id> --failed` fixed it.
- develop merged back; main is an ancestor of develop. All release branches and worktrees are cleaned up.
- Review ledger frontier: 157ccc4e2..af60e8895 pass. The next ship needs a lead-review range sweep from af60e8895 to HEAD.
- Patch notes for v0.50.3-v0.50.5: Mac board topic patch-notes-0505.
- Shared Mac daemon NOT swapped (still a develop cfb174dd7 build, 0.50.2-dev). Swap only when no Pi worker is running anywhere.

OPEN OWNER CHECK
- (1317) Electron auto-update: install the v0.50.4 Werkschaft-win32-x64.zip on Windows (v0.50.3 has no zip), launch it, and see whether it updates to 0.50.5. The updater reads GitHub releases/latest and works only from an installed or packaged build. On failure, read shell.log, the Crashpad logs and the updater logs, following the Windows host rules (unique ws-wintest run folder, kill only your own PID).

READY CLEANUP (owner 06:53)
- b6e0f63d7 closed 261114-feat-ws-dashboard-selection-mention-note (done), 261116-bug-ws-dashboard-hidden-cached-page-cost (done; its no-cache direction was later reversed by (1244)=a) and 261113-feat-ws-dashboard-frontend-performance-profile-and-optimize (dropped, superseded). Owner (1318)=b keeps the other 13 in ready/: they are partial or not started, blocked on acceptance runs or prerequisites. 261117-feat-ws-harness-capability-catalog is implemented on track/agent-v2 (85ef24622), owned by another session, and needs only integration.

SPRINT SESSION (backlog lead), as of 07:09 KST
- Landed: folder-button left-docked sheet (cc5923ef2, mockup e9512f4fa); MCP pi.list/pi.wait show finished Pi children as sleep, deleted only when the session file is missing (e33d6ad71); whiteboard wb:body retirement playbook change (4fd1b36bb, 9ffd62ea2); 261117-feat-ws-tracker-view-summary-delta settled and promoted to ready (3b0f0ca6d).
- Owner (1342)=a ran two Pi workers in parallel in pooled worktrees. At 07:23 KST item 1 is still running, with no commits yet.
  1. 261117-feat-ws-tracker-view-summary-delta Phase 1 on impl/develop/ember-bunny-cacti. Server side: checkpointed incremental fold, per-item summary hash diff, opaque <epoch>.<generation> cursor, a 64-generation ring, inline reset. Ticket lease on track develop. Large risk (correctness and tests). Do NOT merge after Phase 1; Phase 2 (page) stacks on the same impl branch through lead-run. ETA ~10:00. After the Phase 1 measurements, ticket a follow-up for a persisted cold-start fold snapshot (out of this ticket's scope).
  2. DONE 07:23 KST: spawn feed sleep/deleted merged and pushed as 291a403f9 (no ticket; follow-up to e33d6ad71). The dashboard agent feed shows settled ws-spawned Pi children as sleep, or deleted when the session file is gone; native rows keep done. Render-only, T1. Narrow Go tests and the Playwright popover acceptance passed. It is a binary change, so it needs the next daemon swap.
- Do not touch: impl/develop/ember-bunny-cacti while its worker runs; the untracked captures and mockups in the Mac main checkout ((1322)=c, the owner keeps them); catalog P1 on track/agent-v2 ((1321)=c, another session's).

1.
